headline: Green House / M2 Senos Arquitectos
context: Casa Verde is located in Costa Nova do Prado, a Portuguese Atlantic beach famous for its “palheiros”—originally storage buildings used in fishing, which over generations transformed into colorful striped houses, delighting the holidaymakers lucky enough to pass through.
